sections.Profile:
Fore , released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in 1973, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine with a golf theme. Designed by Jim Patla and featuring artwork by Dave Christensen, this single-player game incorporates two flippers, mechanical reels for scorekeeping, and various bumpers and targets.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1973
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Golf, Sports, Original Theme, 1970s, Single level playfield
